name: Kenney Modular Buildings

analyzed_style.perspective: Isometric dimetric projection at approximately 30-degree elevation angle, viewed from a consistent upper-right camera position. Objects are rendered with three visible faces (top, left-front, right-front) following a standard isometric grid alignment.
analyzed_style.rendering: Pre-rendered 3D to 2D sprite output with soft ambient occlusion and gentle diffuse lighting from an upper-left light source. Surfaces use flat-to-subtly-graduated shading with minimal specular highlights. Textures are extremely simplified — nearly flat color fills per face with slight tonal variation to indicate light direction. Anti-aliased edges create smooth silhouettes. Shadows are baked softly into the geometry rather than cast externally.
analyzed_style.line_weight: No outlines whatsoever. Form is defined entirely through face-to-face tonal contrast, soft ambient occlusion at edges and joints, and subtle shading gradients. Edges between faces are crisp but achieved through color difference rather than drawn lines.
analyzed_style.mood: Calm, neutral, minimalist architectural/construction feel. Clean and orderly with a slightly warm, muted aesthetic reminiscent of wooden building blocks or architectural maquettes. Quiet and understated — functional game pieces without dramatic flair.
analyzed_style.scale: Small square sprites approximately 80-120px per asset, fitting a consistent isometric tile grid. Proportions are chunky and compact with slightly simplified, toylike geometric forms. Objects appear as miniature building components at a uniform modular scale.
analyzed_style.background: Fully transparent background with no drop shadow or ground plane. Assets are cleanly isolated with anti-aliased edges against transparency, suitable for direct compositing onto any game scene.
analyzed_style.materials: Stone/masonry: warm beige-tan (#D9C6AD to #C4A882) with minimal surface texture, differentiated by flat face shading. Dark stone/slate: deep charcoal-grey (#3A3540 to #4E4955) with similarly flat treatment. Window/glass: muted steel-blue (#5A8BAF) with a subtle lighter reflection band. Terracotta/brick: warm reddish-brown (#A0573E) used for arch and frame elements. Accent trim: thin teal-green bands on stacked elements suggesting decorative mortar or trim. All materials are rendered with extremely low texture frequency — near-solid color per face.
analyzed_style.detail_level: Low — surfaces are nearly flat-colored with form communicated through face shading and ambient occlusion rather than surface texture. No visible mortar lines, wood grain, or fine ornamentation. Window panes are simple colored rectangles. Decorative elements are reduced to minimal color bands. The style prioritizes clean geometric readability over material realism.

generation_hints: Render in isometric dimetric projection at a 30-degree elevation angle viewed from a consistent upper-right camera position, showing three visible faces (top, left-front, right-front) aligned to a standard isometric grid. Use a pre-rendered 3D-to-2D sprite approach with soft ambient occlusion baked into geometry edges and gentle diffuse lighting from an upper-left source; stone and masonry surfaces are near-flat warm beige-tan with minimal tonal graduation per face, dark slate surfaces use deep charcoal-grey with equally flat treatment, window elements are muted steel-blue with a subtle lighter reflection band, and terracotta/brick accents are warm reddish-brown used sparingly on arch and frame elements. Key material colors are warm beige (#D9C6AD–#C4A882), dark charcoal (#3A3540–#4E4955), muted purple-grey (#8B7A9C), steel-blue (#5A8BAF), and reddish-brown (#A0573E). Proportions are chunky, compact, and toylike — miniature building-block scale fitting an 80–120px isometric tile grid. Use absolutely no outlines; all edges are defined purely through face-to-face tonal contrast and soft ambient occlusion at joints. Lighting is baked softly into surfaces with no external cast shadows. Surface detail is extremely low — near-solid color fills per face with no mortar lines, wood grain, or fine ornamentation. Background must be fully transparent with clean anti-aliased edges, no drop shadow, and no ground plane.
